about: Canonical blocked slugs (PWC59). A row state is blocked:<slug>. coverage_report warns on any other blocked slug unless the row carries a reason. scripts/slug_normalize.mjs reads this file; edit it by hand.

time-stop.why: both name a change to how time runs for a holder, area or world; the sampled time-stop rows are day-length and time-flow rules, the same law as time-manipulation

future-vision.why: a vision of what comes is the sense-the-future law that precognition names (16 rows)

luck-field.why: a law field over chance is the same change to odds that luck-mechanism names (2 rows)

needs-.why: one slug; the input (wax, fox, zither, spoken words, a marked location) goes in the row field needs. The law is the same: a working that requires a named input the row does not supply

distinct.divination: senses hidden information; the law reads what is hidden
distinct.divination-fate: bends or foretells an outcome set by fate or destiny (a standing condition or a doom), a different law from reading hidden facts
distinct.roles-unchecked: Gu move whose roles a wiki label named and a second reader confirmed, no chapter check yet; roles-unknown has no roles at all
distinct.roles-unknown: Gu move with no named component or order yet; needs a chapter pass first. One ledger, so a lookup, not a law (PWC66)
distinct.soul-state: a condition of the soul (damaged, shattered, reforged, held)
distinct.soul-binding: a soul pledged or tied to another party by contract or link; the contract and bond laws read it
distinct.time-loop: rewind that keeps memory or gains; a reset law, not a stop or a rate change
distinct.death-checkpoint-rewind: death returns the holder to a saved point; a trigger plus a reset owned by the death rules
distinct.timeline-split: one world becomes several branches; needs branching worlds, which no other time slug does
distinct.memory-transfer: copies or moves memory between holders; memory-erasure removes it, so the laws differ
distinct.memory-erasure: removes or blocks a holder memory; memory-transfer copies it, so the laws differ
distinct.luck-mechanism: changes the odds a holder meets, own or others, often with a cost
distinct.portal-space: a portal object or doorway between places in one world
distinct.dimension-travel: entry into a navigable other level or regio
distinct.world-travel: travel between worlds or off the local world
distinct.effect-sentence: hp_potions titles that do not say what they do; the fix is a written effect sentence (a lookup), unlike effect-unknown where the source is silent
distinct.effect-unknown: the source does not state the effect; needs reading
distinct.mind-state: a condition of the mind (mood, focus, impairment)
distinct.mind-binding: binds, rules or compels another mind
distinct.mind-ennoblement: raises a mind or nature; 32 rows kept apart until they are read for a law
